claims.text: The preserved Gemini API release notes record a dense March sequence including Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Preview and Nano Banana 2 on March 3, the multimodal gemini-embedding-2-preview on March 10, combined built-in tools and function calling on March 18, Gemini 3.1 Flash Live Preview on March 26, and Veo 3.1 Lite Preview on March 31.
claims.context: First-party API release notes. Model positioning and capability descriptions remain Google claims; chronology and listed API/model identifiers are directly present in the preserved snapshot.

limitations.text: The release-note snapshot verifies dated entries but does not independently reproduce model quality, latency, cost-efficiency, or tool-use performance claims.

editorial.why_now_note: Gemini API had multiple material March model and developer-platform changes spanning lightweight models, multimodal embeddings, tool composition, real-time audio, image generation, and video generation.
